basics.name: Lamine Chikhaoui, MD
basics.label: Physician-Researcher · Epidemiology · Biostatistics · Digital Health
basics.summary: Family Medicine physician with three years of clinical experience and graduate training in Epidemiology. Interested in medical research, data analysis, and applied epidemiology.

work.name: FIU Robert Stempel College of Public Health & Social Work
work.summary: IRB-approved longitudinal cancer survivorship study integrating wearable-derived digital biomarkers and biological measures, in collaboration with the College of Engineering & Computing.
highlights: Coordinate community-based recruitment, screening, informed consent, and longitudinal follow-up
Conduct standardized assessments including cognitive screening (MoCA) and validated surveys
Manage and validate data in REDCap, ensuring quality, completeness, and audit readiness
Perform data cleaning and analysis for epidemiologic research
Ensure IRB, HIPAA, and CITI compliance across all research activities
Collaborate with investigators, coordinators, and engineers on protocols, data pipelines, and SOP development

work.name: Tunisia Ministry of Health
work.position: Family Medicine Resident Doctor / Medical Intern
work.summary: Delivered inpatient, outpatient, and emergency care across multiple specialties within public teaching hospitals.
highlights: Provided care across internal medicine, endocrinology, pediatrics, surgery, psychiatry, obstetrics, dermatology, and occupational medicine
Managed complex cardiovascular, respiratory, endocrine, renal, neurological, and mental health conditions
Delivered acute and emergency care, including on-call coverage in high-volume hospitals
Participated in national public health initiatives: immunization, chronic disease prevention, and early cancer detection
Documented care using electronic medical records across large, diverse patient populations

volunteer.summary: Performed COVID-19 PCR and rapid testing in support of public health efforts.
